theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_ll_gws_lipschitz_ibp
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (b : Eucl n → Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ Ω → ∃ g : Eucl n → ℝ, Integrable g (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∀ (L : ℝ≥0) (f : Eucl n → ℝ), LipschitzOnWith L f Ω → IntegrableOn (fun w => f w * g w) Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∫ w in Ω, fderiv ℝ f w (b w) = -∫ w in Ω, f w * g w
